topic: Self-Attention Costs Double When You Double Text Length
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯 AI memory explodes quadratically!

Ever wonder why super long prompts make AI models like ChatGPT chug? Here's the mind-blowing reality:

🔹 Doubling the length of text you give an AI makes its processing effort *quadruple*, not just double!
🔹 This is due to 'self-attention': every single word needs to consider every other word to understand context.
🔹 So, those really long conversations or code analyses aren't just a little more work for the AI—they're vastly more expensive in terms of computation!
